who: Prince's board, connected by Prince; compiled, flashed and read over serial by Claude Code at his request
board: ESP32 DevKit (CP210x USB-UART), chip ESP32-D0WD-V3 rev 3.1, 40 MHz crystal, 4 MB flash
toolchain: arduino-cli 1.0.4, esp32 Arduino core 3.0.6, compiler flags -Os (Arduino default), FQBN esp32:esp32:esp32:CPUFreq=240
model: export/esp32_infer: tiny MLP INT8, channel D-2, training seed 0, 3,540 weight bytes, 3,344 MACs/inference (IN_DIM 88)
method: micros() around back-to-back infer() calls on one stored window; mean per call; repeated per window

energy_estimate_uJ.basis: MEASURED latency x 3.3 V x 30-68 mA (ESP32 datasheet, modem-sleep 240 MHz, radio off); current NOT measured

not_measured: power/current, other channels' models (MSL models have IN_DIM 118, ~29% more MACs), dual-core use, -O2 builds
